Name: LOOK_AT_HEAD_PARAM_ST
Description: Determines the parameters relating to look-at cameras for heads.

Fields.Name: Turning Performance
Fields.Description: The interpolation performance when LookAt is enabled or disabled. In % per second.

Fields.Name: Vertical Correction Rate
Fields.Description: How far the head turns towards the target angle vertically (0.0 to 1.0).

Fields.Name: Horizontal Correction Rate
Fields.Description: How far the head turns towards the target angle horizontally (0.0 to 1.0).

Fields.Name: Minimum Vertical Angle
Fields.Description: The downward limit angle of the head look-at. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Maximum Vertical Angle
Fields.Description: The upward limit angle of the head look-at. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Minimum Horizontal Angle
Fields.Description: The left limit angle of the head look-at. In degrees.

Fields.Name: Maximum Horizontal Angle
Fields.Description: The right limit angle of the head look-at. In degrees.
